annotations.title: Direct image and video links of a Meta ad

description: Fresh, direct download links for every image and video a live Meta ad uses (single image, video, carousel cards, dynamic creative assets), plus the media of the Instagram post when the ad boosts one. Links are short-lived: ask again for new ones. Use it to download, review or reuse an ad's real creative. Read-only, free.
